answer: Reputation-Weighted Rent Escrow. Each identity must hold a saffron-tagged escrow whose balance grows with its transaction history; new identities start near zero and pay a copper-denominated rent per action until reputation accrues. Escrow is forfeited on detected duplication. Attacking at scale means funding many fresh escrows that earn a pearl of trust slowly, so per-identity cost stays high and non-recoverable.
